title: Sending and Missions
definition: Sending and Missions is the Church's participation in Christ's commission by sending workers, supporting Gospel labor, and proclaiming Christ among all peoples.
summary: Sending and Missions focuses on the Church's responsibility to pray for, support, and send Gospel workers.
christFocus: Jesus Christ sends His witnesses to the nations with the message of repentance and forgiveness.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: This doctrine is about the church as a sending body. While every believer is a witness, some are set apart and sent for focused Gospel work across cultures, regions, or unreached places. Sending includes discernment, commissioning, support, accountability, and ongoing care.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because missions can become sentimental interest without local church responsibility. The New Testament shows churches praying, giving, sending, and receiving reports. Faithful sending helps workers avoid isolation and helps congregations share in Gospel advance.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Know whom your church supports and pray for them by name. Give toward Gospel work with informed love. Encourage leaders to prepare, send, and care for workers rather than treating missions as a distant project.
